g.text: The Evals page: what it is made of: louis-agent.web.evals, Pages / Running / Evals
evals, a run started, the run
asks for the admin key when the API says no
whether the run store is up
every eval with its last result
the run in progress, turn by turn
what the chosen eval proves, its runs and its controls
A box inside a box is held by it.

text.tspan: The page holds the list of evals and the one chosen; the chosen eval's details start a run, and the live panel follows it until it ends.
